nodes.name: Acid treatment of ATO
nodes.procedure: One gram of ATO was suspended in 50 mL of HCl (37 wt%) and held at 65°C for 1 h under stirring. The sample was centrifuged and washed several times with ultrapure water until neutral pH followed by drying in a vacuum oven at 70°C overnight to obtain the acid-treated ATO (ATO.AT).
nodes.source_text: Acid treatment of the ATO powder was carried out to clean and activate the surface. One gram of ATO was suspended in 50 mL of HCl (37 wt%)...

nodes.name: MW-assisted polyol synthesis (general)
nodes.procedure: The electrocatalysts were synthesized using MW-assisted polyol method using a CEM Discovery SP® microwave synthesizer operated in dynamic power mode with maximum power 200 W. As an example, the required amount of IrCl₃·H₂O solution in ultrapure water was mixed with ethylene glycol to obtain reaction bath having ethylene glycol/water ratio of 3:7 (ν/ν) and Ir concentration of 5 mmol L⁻¹. The required amount of support (ATO or ATO.AT) was dispersed in 20 mL reaction mixture by ultrasonication 60 s at RT. Mixture transferred to 35 mL glass reactor, exposed to microwaves 20 min at predefined temperature (140°C or 160°C). After cooling, collected by centrifugation 4000 rpm 5 min, washed with ultrapure water, dried overnight at 60°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show Ir NPs with average particle diameter of ~2 nm, well-dispersed on ATO.AT support surface, with 65% particles smaller than 2.5 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The histogram determined by measuring >200 particles under the assumption of spherical like units shows the Ir average particle diameter of ∼2 nm (Fig. S2c), well-dispersed on the support surface (Fig. 3f).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows agglomerated ATO.AT structure with good crystallinity and particle size range of 5-10 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM images show agglomerated structure of the ATO.AT with good crystallinity at the edges of the agglomerates (Fig. 2a, b) with high resolution. The NPs are in the range from 5 to 10 nm (Fig. S2a, b).

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern exhibits circular ring diffraction belonging to polycrystalline tetragonal SnO2 (P42/mnm) for ATO.AT support.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SAED (selected area electron diffraction) pattern (inset of Fig. 2a and magnified image Fig. S3a) exhibits a circular ring diffraction pattern, where the rings belong to the polycrystalline ATO.AT support.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED shows rings assigned to (110), (101), (211), (301) lattice planes of ATO.AT and diffuse ring fitting Ir (111) d-spacing indicating amorphous Ir NPs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SAED pattern (inset of Fig. 3a and magnified image Fig. S3b) exhibits a circular ring diffraction pattern, where the rings assigned to the (110), (101), (211) and (301) lattice planes of ATO.AT...

nodes.characterization_summary: N2 adsorption shows BET surface area of ~55 m²/g for ATO and ~57 m²/g for ATO.AT with pore size distribution maximum at 7.2 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The BET surface areas of the ATO and ATO.AT samples are observed to be ∼55 and ∼57 m²g⁻¹, respectively... The pore size distribution plots have maxima at around 7.2 nm for both ATO and ATO.AT.

nodes.characterization_summary: PXRD shows broad weak peak at 2θ ~40.8° corresponding to Ir (111) confirming metallic Ir NPs presence; other peaks from ATO support.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All electrocatalysts exhibit a broad and weak diffraction peak at 2θ value ∼40.8° corresponding to the (111) diffraction from the Ir crystals (JCPDS: 87-0715).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS for Ir/ATO.AT-40-140 shows Ir 4f7/2 peaks at 61.3 eV (Ir⁰) and 63.4 eV (Ir⁴⁺); Sb 3d3/2 at 540.7 eV (Sb⁵⁺); Sn 3d5/2 at 487.4 eV and 3d3/2 at 495.9 eV (Sn⁴⁺).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ir 4f for Ir/ATO.AT-40-140 show 4f7/2 and 4f5/2 spin-orbit doublet with the more intense 4f7/2 component at 61.3 and 63.4 eV representing the Ir⁰ and Ir⁴⁺ [19,47,61,62], respectively (Fig. 5c).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS for Ir/ATO.AT-40-160 shows shifted binding energies: Ir 4f7/2 at 60.7 eV, 4f5/2 at 62.8 eV (reduced Ir valence); Sb 3d5/2 at 530.9 eV, 3d3/2 at 540.2 eV (Sb⁵⁺); Sn⁴⁺ components also shifted lower.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the higher synthesis temperature of 160°C, the binding energy values for Sb, Sn and Ir are shifted to lower values for Ir/ATO.AT-40-160 electrocatalyst (Fig. 5d-f)... Ir/Ir⁴⁺ 4f doublet at 60.7 (4f7/2) and 62.8 (4f5/2) (Table S3).
